name: hei-bai-he
description: 黑百盒 —— 黑白盒测试平台（单机版）：业务流程建模、双视图流程画布、执行发光动画、输入输出匹对校验

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n 服务端,前端界面 -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:frontend && npm run verify && npm run build
